summary.text: Hannah Beth Rivera is the Republican candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 93 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Democrat Adrielle Camuel.

Rivera is an attorney who, in a Ballotpedia survey, described a career in higher education policy and government relations, including as chief of staff at the Kentucky Community and Technical College System.

paragraphs.text: Hannah Beth Rivera earned a high school diploma from North Laurel High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Louisville in 2007 and a law degree from the University of Kentucky College of Law in 2010.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lifelong Kentuckian and attorney with more than fifteen years of experience in higher education policy, government relations and public service.
She said she served as Chief of Staff and Vice President for External Affairs at the Kentucky Community and Technical College System (KCTCS) and previously as its Manager of Government Affairs.
Rivera advanced from the Republican primary after the May 19, 2026, primary was canceled.
In the survey, she listed addressing the cost of living, increasing government transparency and bringing civility back to politics as her key campaign messages.
She named education, workforce and criminal justice reform as the policy areas she is most passionate about.
